passive.name: Sky-Piercing Fang
passive.text: CRIT Rate increased by **4/5/6/7/8%**. Gains Skypiercing Might upon using an Elemental Burst: Increases Movement SPD by **10%**, increases ATK SPD by **10%**, and Normal and Charged hits deal additional DMG equal to **20/25/30/35/40%** of ATK. Skypiercing Might lasts for 12s.

passive.name: Composed
passive.text: After damaging an opponent with an Elemental Skill, the skill has a **40/50/60/70/80%** chance to end its own CD. Can only occur once every **30/26/22/19/16**s.

passive.name: Undying Admiration
passive.text: Increases Elemental Skill DMG by **16/20/24/28/32%** and Elemental Skill CRIT Rate by **6/7.5/9/10.5/12%**.

substatLine: ATK% > CRIT DMG > CRIT Rate > Energy Recharge

entries.name: Foreign Thundershock
entries.text:
**Normal Attack**
Performs up to 5 rapid strikes.

**Charged Attack**
Consumes a certain amount of Stamina to unleash 2 rapid sword strikes.

**Plunging Attack**
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

entries.name: Lightning Blade
entries.text:
Unleashes three swift thunder shadows that deal **Electro DMG** to opponents and leave an Abundance Amulet behind after hitting an opponent.
2 Abundance Amulets can be created initially. Using this skill will reset any Abundance Amulets that were generated.

**Abundance Amulets**
When a character is near an Abundance Amulet, they will absorb it and obtain the following effects:
·Restores Elemental Energy
·Increases Energy Recharge during the Abundance Amulet's duration.

You and Paimon discuss the paths by which electricity might flow.

entries.name: Bellowing Thunder
entries.text:
You call upon the protection of lightning, knocking nearby opponents back and dealing **Electro DMG** to them.

**Lightning Shroud**
When your active character's Normal or Charged Attacks hit opponents, they will call Falling Thunder forth, dealing **Electro DMG**.
When Falling Thunder hits opponents, it will regenerate Energy for that character.
One instance of Falling Thunder can be generated every 0.5s.

You and Paimon studied the light that flashes through the clouds.

entries.name: Thunderflash
entries.text: When another nearby character in the party obtains an Abundance Amulet created by **Lightning Blade**, **Lightning Blade's** CD is decreased by 1.5s.

entries.name: Resounding Roar
entries.text: Increases the Energy Recharge effect granted by **Lightning Blade**'s Abundance Amulet by 10% of the Traveler's Energy Recharge.

entries.name: Foreign Thundertrail
entries.text:
Draw new strength from journeys past. For every element you have resonated with, you gain additional **buffs**.

In addition, when nearby party members unleash an Elemental Burst, Traveler will receive 1 stack of Blade of Resounding Thunder, max 3 stacks. After obtaining 3 stacks of Blade of Resounding Thunder, performing a Charged Attack will consume all stacks of Blade of Resounding Thunder and transform into the special **Charged Attack: Detonate**.

**Charged Attack: Detonate**
· Each Charged Attack hit deals increased **Electro DMG**. Increase in DMG is equal to 100% of Traveler's ATK.
· 3s after hitting the enemy, 1 additional lightning strike will be triggered, dealing **Electro DMG** equal to 200% of Traveler's ATK. 1 Abundance Amulet will also be created. This DMG is considered Charged Attack DMG.
· **Charged Attack: Detonate** can be triggered up to once every 15s.

entries.name: Spring Thunder of Fertility
entries.text: The number of Abundance Amulets that can be generated using **Lightning Blade** is increased to 3.

entries.name: Violet Vehemence
entries.text: When Falling Thunder created by **Bellowing Thunder** hits an opponent, it will decrease their **Electro RES** by 15% for 8s.

entries.name: Distant Crackling
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Bellowing Thunder** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: Fickle Cloudstrike
entries.text: When a character obtains Abundance Amulets generated by **Lightning Blade**, if this character's Energy is less than 35%, the Energy restored by the Abundance Amulets is increased by 100%.

entries.name: Clamor in the Wilds
entries.text:
Increases the Level of **Lightning Blade** by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

entries.name: World-Shaker
entries.text: Every 2 Falling Thunder attacks triggered by **Bellowing Thunder** will greatly increase the DMG dealt by the next Falling Thunder, which will deal 200% of its original DMG and will restore an additional 1 Energy to the current character.
